page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.cm4.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with an Intel Xeon E5-2667 v4 processor operating at a clock speed of 3.2 GHz. The instance is configured with 4 dedicated vCPUs derived from 2 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. It includes 16.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. There is no local storage bundled with this instance, and network connectivity is limited to a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates that the ecs.cm4.xlarge generally delivers entry-level performance across most workloads. In stress-ng and Geekbench tests, both single-core and multi-core CPU performance fall into the bottom 25% tier. Memory bandwidth tests show weak to poor results, with large-block read-only bandwidth falling into the bottom 10% tier at 21.26 GB/sec. However, the instance demonstrates average performance in single-threaded gzip compression and bzip3 decompression, as well as text processing and text generation for small 135M parameter language models.

Given the dedicated CPU allocation but older Intel Xeon E5-2667 v4 architecture, the instance offers a predictable but modest compute profile. The lack of local storage requires external block storage attachment, which may impact overall I/O performance depending on the network baseline of 2 Gbps. This instance is best suited for lightweight general-purpose workloads, such as basic web serving, text processing, and simple utility scripting, where high-throughput memory or intensive multi-threaded computation is not required.
